title: Name and the nickname Cie
summary: Frazier spells his name and explains the Creole-derived nickname Cie, used since school days.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Josiah Fraser. How do you spell that? J-O-S-I-A-H.
How do you spell your nickname there, your little name?
Well, they generally call me C-I-E.
C-I-E. Some say S-I-E, but they were always pronounced as C-I-E.
What's that? Is that sort of a French nickname?
Oh, yeah. Well, it's adopted through the Creole people, you know, as a nickname from the name. The word Josiah, you see, is adopted from the Creole. Originated, started from the school days, S-I-E.
You had it all your life?
All my life you can say, yeah. And, well, let's see, I first started playing.
